name: truo-img
description: URL builder and framework loaders for img.truo.cloud
//workspace: A workspace of its own, deliberately outside packages/*. The three packages there share a single version because they all come out of the same commit of the same OpenAPI spec; these do not. Their version tracks the URL contract, they need real peerDependencies (a loader must never bundle next/vue/@angular/common), and they must not be blocked by a spec drift they have nothing to do with. Same reasoning that already keeps docs/ out of the workspace.
